Ethyl Acetate

  • Formula: C4H8O2
  • Molecular weight: 88.1051
  • IUPAC Standard InChI: InChI=1S/C4H8O2/c1-3-6-4(2)5/h3H2,1-2H3
  • IUPAC Standard InChIKey: XEKOWRVHYACXOJ-UHFFFAOYSA-N
  • CAS Registry Number: 141-78-6
  • Chemical structure:
